editorialNarrative.hook: Zheng's home milestone meets Andreeva's fifth final of 2026 in Beijing.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: The China Open singles final pairs wildcard Qinwen Zheng with fourth seed Mirra Andreeva. Zheng is the first Chinese player to reach this final; Andreeva brings a season already featuring three titles. Capital Group Diamond hosts the final on 11 October, not before 19:30 Beijing / 22:30 Sydney, after the doubles final. The announced time remains a not-before start.
editorialNarrative.formCopy: Both arrive after straight-sets semifinals. Andreeva is in her fifth final of the season, following titles at Roland Garros, Adelaide and Linz and a Madrid final. Their only earlier tour meeting was a three-set Beijing quarter-final in 2024, where Zheng had the advantage. That history gives the match context without deciding this final.
editorialNarrative.closingCopy: Zheng's chance to become the first Chinese singles champion at the China Open gives the home crowd a clear story. Andreeva has the fourth seed and a strong season behind her. The final asks whether Zheng can turn that local milestone into a title, or Andreeva can add another trophy. Those are possibilities, with the result still to be decided.
